lesson_title: A Year of Shape and Measure
hook_text: One camp near Clarens uses every shape and measurement skill from the year. Can you spot them all?
clip_script: Camp near Clarens. Tents: triangular prisms. Water tank: a cylinder. Hexagon tiles with no gaps. Bus: 07:15 to 11:40, that is 4 hours 25 minutes, not 3 hours 85. Hike: 3 and 1/2 km, 3 500 m. Water: 1 and 1/2 litres each, 36 litres for 24 learners. Campfire vote: hiking wins, the mode. Tent floor: 12 squares inside, 14 units around. Cool box: 15 in a layer, 2 layers, 30. Look carefully, pick the unit, check it makes sense.
visual_style: A camp map with each area labelled by the skill it uses, ticking off one by one.
mood: Outdoorsy and proud, like the last adventure of the school year.
pacing: Rapid tour from the tents to the bus to the campfire, one skill per beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and do one practice question from every shape and measurement topic.
